notes: Weir DisperseV2 (contracts only) on Robinhood Chain (chainId 4663). One contract, src/DisperseV2.sol, no constructor arguments: an ownerless, feeless, stateless helper that pays many recipients one ERC-20 in a single transaction with transferFrom from the caller, optionally emitting a public payout reference and messages. src/Disperse.sol (v1) is already deployed at 0x49959c0326c4dF604a4d62D46CCBAe3C056CC158 and is NOT to be deployed again. No new token, pool, distributor or website.
